summary: Kanzhun Limited, a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed (stock code 02076) foreign private issuer with weighted voting rights, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 23, 2026, its US equivalent of a routine equity-issuance notification. The return reports 20,400 new Class A shares issued on exercise of share options at USD 3.1248 per share, 596,064 Class A shares from vesting of restricted share units, and conversion of 10,710,440 Class B shares into Class A shares on September 22, 2026, leaving 829,594,733 Class A and 110,996,801 Class B shares outstanding. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms arise; watch only routine dilution and dual-class conversion pacing.
